args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Attempted rollback to the most recent healthy version (v2.3.0)**: This failed because v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it could not be deployed.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent release that was healthy in production), applied to all production regions.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: "checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.2.9", documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the error rate, the quarantine of v2.3.0 due to CVE-2026-4417, and the rollback to v2.2.9. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Additional note: since v2.3.0 is quarantined for a CVE, the engineering/chongc team may want to prioritize a patched release forward, as v2.2.9 is now the only production-healthy version.
